stem: Which one of the following cities is not located on the bank of river Ganga?
expl: The prime tributary of Ganga river is Bhagirathi which originates from Gomukh, Uttarkashi district in Uttarakhand. The confluence of Alaknanda and Bhagirathi at Devprayag forms river Ganga. Thus, Uttarkashi is related to Bhagirathi not Ganga. Fatehpur, Bhagalpur, and Kanpur are located on the bank of river Ganga.
"Leh" is located on the right bank of Indus river in the State of Jammu and Kashmir (when the question asked). At present it is located in the UT of Ladakh, (since 31 October, 2019).

stem: Consider the following information: In how many of the above rows is the given information correctly matched?
expl: The Dhuandhar waterfall is in Jabalpur district in Madhya Pradesh, which is created by river Narmada. Jabalpur is not located in the Malwa region. It lies in the Mahakoshal region. Hence, information given in row 1 is not correctly matched. The Hundru waterfall is located in Ranchi district in Jharkhand which lies in Chota Nagpur region. It is created on the course of the Subarnarekha River. Hence, information given in row 2 is correctly matched. Gersoppa waterfall, also known as Jog Falls, lies on the Sharavati River in Karnataka in the Western Ghats. So, information given in row 3 is not correctly matched.

stem:

expl: Betul is a district of Madhya Pradesh. Tapti (Tapi) river originates in the Betul district from a place called Multai. Ujjain: Ujjain is the oldest city in the Malwa region of Madhya Pradesh. It is located on the eastern bank of Kshipra river.

stem: Which one of the following is not located along the Mandakini river ?
expl: Gaurikund, Rambara and Guptakashi are located along the Mandakini river, whereas Govindghat is located at the confluence of Alaknanda and Lakshman Ganga.

stem:

1. Pandharpur Chandrabhaga
2. Tiruchirappalli Cauvery
3. Hampi Malaprabha
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
expl: Located on the bank of the Tungabhadra River, Hampi was the capital of Vijayanagar . It is famous for many temples like Virupaksha temple, Vithala temple, and Nandi statue. Pandharpur is a well-known pilgrimage town on the banks of Chandrabhaga River in Maharashtra. Tiruchirappalli is situated on the banks of the Cauvery River. It was a citadel of the early Cholas which later fell to the Pallavas.
